arxiv-1811-12932.title: Recurrent machines for likelihood-free inference
arxiv-1811-12932.creator: Arthur Pesah, Antoine Wehenkel, Gilles Louppe
arxiv-1811-12932.description: Abstract Likelihood-free inference is concerned with the estimation of the parameters of a non-differentiable stochastic simulator that best reproduce real observations. In the absence of a likelihood function, most of the existing inference methods optimize the simulator parameters through a handcrafted iterative procedure that tries to make the simulated data more similar to the observations.

arxiv-1812-02978.title: More or Less? Predict the Social Influence of Malicious URLs on Social Media
arxiv-1812-02978.creator: Chun-Ming Lai 1 , Xiaoyun Wang 1 , Jon W. Chapman 1 , Yu-Cheng Lin 1 , Yu-Chung Ho 1 , S. Felix Wu 1 , Patrick McDaniel 2 and Hasan Cam 3
arxiv-1812-02978.description: Abstract Users of Online Social Networks (OSNs) interact with each other more than ever. In the context of a public discussion group, people receive, read, and write comments in response to articles and postings. In the absence of access control mechanisms, OSNs are a great environment for attackers to influence others, from spreading phishing URLs, to posting fake news.

arxiv-1902-10654.title: Register Games \rsuper * Thanks: Research supported by the Israel Science Foundation grant 1373/16 and the EPSRC grant EP/P020909/1 (Solving Parity Games in Theory and Practice)
arxiv-1902-10654.creator: Karoliina Lehtinen, Udi Boker
arxiv-1902-10654.description: Abstract . The complexity of parity games is a long standing open problem that saw a major breakthrough in 2017 when two quasi-polynomial algorithms were published. This article presents a third, independent approach to solving parity games in quasi-polynomial time, based on the notion of register game , a parameterised variant of a parity game.

arxiv-2101-08693.title: Quantum Correlations in Space-Time: Foundations and Applications
arxiv-2101-08693.creator: Tian Zhang
arxiv-2101-08693.description: Abstract The absolute/relative debate on the nature of space and time is ongoing for thousands of years. Here we attempt to investigate space and time from the information theoretic point of view to understand spatial and temporal correlations under the relative assumption.

arxiv-2102-05226.title: Optimal Design of Membrane Cascades for Gaseous and Liquid Mixtures via MINLP
arxiv-2102-05226.creator: Jose Adrian Chavez Velasco ‡, Radhakrishna Tumbalam Gooty ‡, Mohit Tawarmalani †, Rakesh Agrawal ∗
arxiv-2102-05226.description: Abstract Given the growing concern of reducing CO 2 emissions, it is desirable to identify, for a given separation carried out through a membrane cascade, the optimum design that yields the lowest energy consumption. Nevertheless, designing a membrane cascade is challenging since, there are often multiple feasible configurations that differ in their energy consumption and cost.

arxiv-2104-07675.title: Decaying Dark Matter: Simulations and Weak-Lensing Forecast
arxiv-2104-07675.creator: and Sambit K. Giri
arxiv-2104-07675.description: Abstract Despite evidence for the existence of dark matter (DM) from very high and low redshifts, a moderate amount of DM particle decay remains a valid possibility. This includes both models with very long-lived yet unstable particles or mixed scenarios where only a small fraction of dark matter is allowed to decay.

arxiv-2105-07906.title: Distributionally Robust Chance-Constrained Flexibility Planning for Integrated Energy System
arxiv-2105-07906.creator: Sen Zhan, Peng Hou, Guangya Yang
arxiv-2105-07906.description: Abstract Inflexible combined heat and power (CHP) plants and uncertain wind power production result in excess power in distribution networks, which leads to inverse power flow challenging grid operations. Power-to-X facilities such as electrolysers and electric boilers can offer extra flexibility to the integrated energy system.

arxiv-2109-03502.title: R2-D2: A Modular Baseline for Open-Domain Question Answering
arxiv-2109-03502.creator: Martin Fajcik, Martin Docekal, Karel Ondrej, Pavel Smrz
arxiv-2109-03502.description: Abstract This work presents a novel four-stage open-domain QA pipeline R2-D2 ( Rank twice , reaD twice ). The pipeline is composed of a retriever, passage reranker, extractive reader, generative reader and a mechanism that aggregates the final prediction from all system’s components.

arxiv-2207-04487.title: Automatic differentiation and the optimization of differential equation models in biology
arxiv-2207-04487.description: Abstract Automatic differentiation and the optimization of differential equation models in biology Steven A. Frank 1 1 footnotemark: 1 A computational revolution unleashed the power of artificial neural networks. At the heart of that revolution is automatic differentiation, which calculates the derivative of a performance measure relative to a large number of parameters.

arxiv-2207-10965.title: A universe born in a metastable false vacuum state needs not die Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2207-10965.creator: K. Urbanowski
arxiv-2207-10965.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by K. Urbanowski. We try to find conditions, the fulfillment of which allows a universe born in a metastable false vacuum state to survive and not to collapse. The conditions found are in the form of inequalities linking the depending on time t t instantaneous decay rate Γ ⁡ ( t ) {\it\Gamma}(t) of the false vacuum state and the Hubble parameter H ⁡ ( t ) H(t) .

arxiv-2305-03531.title: Random Smoothing Regularization in Kernel Gradient Descent Learning
arxiv-2305-03531.creator: Liang Ding, Tianyang Hu, Jiahang Jiang, Donghao Li, Wenjia Wang, Yuan Yao
arxiv-2305-03531.description: Abstract Random smoothing data augmentation is a unique form of regularization that can prevent overfitting by introducing noise to the input data, encouraging the model to learn more generalized features. Despite its success in various applications, there has been a lack of systematic study on the regularization ability of random smoothing.

arxiv-2307-09690.title: Fast Fourier-Chebyshev approach to real-space simulations of the Kubo formula
arxiv-2307-09690.creator: Santiago Giménez de Castro, João M. Viana Parente Lopes, Aires Ferreira, D. A. Bahamon
arxiv-2307-09690.description: Abstract The Kubo formula is a cornerstone in our understanding of near-equilibrium transport phenomena. While conceptually elegant, the application of Kubo’s linear-response theory to interesting problems is hindered by the need for algorithms that are accurate and scalable to large lattice sizes beyond one spatial dimension.

arxiv-2308-02898.title: Elucidate Gender Fairness in Singing Voice Transcription Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29-November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’23), October 29-November 3, 2023, Ottawa, O
arxiv-2308-02898.creator: Xiangming Gu, Wei Zeng, Ye Wang
arxiv-2308-02898.description: Abstract . It is widely known that males and females typically possess different sound characteristics when singing, such as timbre and pitch, but it has never been explored whether these gender-based characteristics lead to a performance disparity in singing voice transcription (SVT), whose target includes pitch.

arxiv-2309-12418.title: Twenty-five years of random asset exchange modeling
arxiv-2309-12418.creator: Max Greenberg, H. Oliver Gao
arxiv-2309-12418.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Max Greenberg, H. Oliver Gao. The last twenty-five years have seen the development of a significant literature within the subfield of econophysics which attempts to model economic inequality as an emergent property of stochastic interactions among ensembles of agents. In this article, the literature surrounding this approach to the study of wealth and income distributions, henceforth the ”random asset exchange” literature following the terminology of Sinha (2003), is thoroughly reviewed for the first time.

arxiv-2404-01643.title: A Closer Look at Spatial-Slice Features Learning for COVID-19 Detection
arxiv-2404-01643.description: Abstract Conventional Computed Tomography (CT) imaging recognition faces two significant challenges: (1) There is often considerable variability in the resolution and size of each CT scan , necessitating strict requirements for the input size and adaptability of models. (2) CT-scan contains large number of out-of-distribution (OOD) slices.

arxiv-2409-16765.title: MaViLS, a Benchmark Dataset for Video-to-Slide Alignment, Assessing Baseline Accuracy with a Multimodal Alignment Algorithm Leveraging Speech, OCR, and Visual Features
arxiv-2409-16765.creator: Katharina Anderer, Andreas Reich, Matthias Wölfel
arxiv-2409-16765.description: Abstract This paper presents a benchmark dataset for aligning lecture videos with corresponding slides and introduces a novel multimodal algorithm leveraging features from speech, text, and images. It achieves an average accuracy of 0.82 in comparison to SIFT (0.56) while being approximately 11 times faster. Using dynamic programming the algorithm tries to determine the optimal slide sequence.

arxiv-2410-11634.title: Spin induction from scattering of two spinning black holes in dense clusters
arxiv-2410-11634.creator: Jorge L. Rodríguez-Monteverde, Santiago Jaraba, Juan García-Bellido
arxiv-2410-11634.description: Abstract In this paper, we use numerical relativity to study the spin induction effect within close hyperbolic encounters of initially spinning black holes. We review the initially non-spinning case and explore the cases of initially aligned, anti-aligned and orthogonal spins with respect to the orbital angular momentum L → \vec{L} .

arxiv-2410-16280.title: Resilience to Non-Compliance in Coupled Cooperating Systems
arxiv-2410-16280.creator: Brooks A. Butler, Philip E. Paré
arxiv-2410-16280.description: Abstract This letter explores the implementation of a safe control law for systems of dynamically coupled cooperating agents. Under a CBF-based collaborative safety framework, we examine how the maximum safety capability for a given agent, which is computed using a collaborative safety condition, influences safety requests made to neighbors.

arxiv-2508-12493.title: Analyticity of the Hausdorff dimension and metric structures on Misiurewicz families of polynomials
arxiv-2508-12493.creator: Fabrizio Bianchi, Yan Mary He
arxiv-2508-12493.description: Abstract . Consider a holomorphic family ( f λ ) λ ∈ Λ (f_{\lambda})_{\lambda\in\Lambda} of polynomial maps on ℂ \mathbb{C} with the property that a critical point of f λ f_{\lambda} is persistently preperiodic to a repelling periodic point of f λ f_{\lambda} .

arxiv-2510-25733.title: The Geometry of BCFW for ABJM Loop Integrands
arxiv-2510-25733.creator: Livia Ferro, Ross Glew, Tomasz Łukowski, and Jonah Stalknecht
arxiv-2510-25733.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the loop-level geometry of ABJM theory from the perspective of lightcone geometries in dual space. This geometry admits a natural fibration, where one of the loop variables can be naturally interpreted as living in a fiber for each fixed point of a lower-loop geometry.

plos-pone-0349758.title: Disparities in prostate cancer screening practices among general practitioners and urologists (PROSHADE study): A cross-sectional study
plos-pone-0349758.creator: Blanca Lumbreras, Lucy A Parker, Pablo Alonso-Coello, Juan-Pablo Caballero-Romeu, Ignacio Párraga-Martínez, Luis Prieto, Irene Moral-Peláez, Mª del Campo-Giménez
plos-pone-0349758.description: Disparities in prostate cancer screening practices among general practitioners and urologists (PROSHADE study): A cross-sectional study

pmc-10661926.title: GNRI, PLR and Stroke-Associated Pneumonia: From Association to Development of a Web-Based Dynamic Nomogram
pmc-10661926.creator: Chunqing Wang, Xiaoyao Jiang, Di Wu, Mengjun Ge, Li Deng
pmc-10661926.description: ObjectiveDiscussing the relationship between geriatric nutritional risk index (GNRI) and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR) on stroke-associated pneumonia (SAP) in acute ischemic stroke (AIS) patients, developing and validating a web-based dynamic nomogram.MethodsA total of 996 AIS patients admitted to the Department of General Medicine and Neurology at Xuzhou Medical University Affiliated Hospital were collected.

pmc-10694302.title: Repurposing catheter ablation work-up to detect expiratory airflow limitation in patients with atrial fibrillation☆
pmc-10694302.creator: Maartje J.M. Hereijgers, Rachel M.J. van der Velden, Nora el Moussaoui, Dominique V.M. Verhaert, Zarina Habibi, Justin Luermans, Dennis den Uijl, Sevasti-Maria Chaldoupi, Kevin Vernooy, Ulrich Schotten, Mathias Baumert, Hester A. Gietema, Casper Mihl, Lukasz Koltowski, Frits M.E. Franssen, Sami O. S
pmc-10694302.description: BackgroundIn atrial fibrillation (AF) patients, presence of expiratory airflow limitation may negatively impact treatment outcomes. AF patients are not routinely screened for expiratory airflow limitation, but existing examinations can help identify at-risk individuals. We aimed to assess the diagnostic value of repurposing existing assessments from the pre-ablation work-up to identify and understand the characteristics of affected patients.

pmc-11348305.title: Phosphorylation of Insig-2 mediates inhibition of fatty acid synthesis by polyunsaturated fatty acids
pmc-11348305.creator: Jing Tian, Joseph L. Goldstein, Shili Li, Marc M. Schumacher, Michael S. Brown
pmc-11348305.description: SignificanceFatty acid synthesis consumes energy. To prevent energy wastage, animals limit fatty acid synthesis by controlling the activity of sterol regulatory element-binding protein-1 (SREBP-1), a transcription factor that activates genes necessary to produce fatty acids. SREBP-1 is synthesized in the endoplasmic reticulum and processed proteolytically to generate the active nuclear fragment.

pmc-11401527.title: Color Doppler Imaging, Endothelin-1, Corneal Biomechanics and Scleral Rigidity in Asymmetric Age-Related Macular Degeneration
pmc-11401527.creator: Alessandro Finzi, Simone Ottoboni, Mauro Cellini, Beniamino Corcioni, Caterina Gaudiano, Luigi Fontana
pmc-11401527.description: PurposeAge-related macular degeneration (AMD) presents a multifaceted etiopathogenesis involving ischemic, inflammatory, and genetic components. This study investigates the correlation between ocular hemodynamics, scleral rigidity (SR), and plasma endothelin-1 (ET1) levels in treatment-naive patients with asymmetrical AMD.Patients and MethodsThis study included 20 treatment-naive patients (12 females and 8 males) with an average age of 76.4 ± 3.

pmc-11415948.title: Urogenital schistosomiasis among school children in northwestern Tanzania: Prevalence, intensity of infection, associated factors, and pattern of urinary tract morbidities
pmc-11415948.creator: Nyanda C Justine, Titus R Leeyio, Antje Fuss, Klaus Brehm, Humphrey D Mazigo, Andreas Mueller
pmc-11415948.description: BackgroundThe planning and implementation of intervention measures against schistosomiasis, particularly mass administration, require knowledge of the current status of the infection. This is important for monitoring the impact of the intervention on disease indicators such as a decline in infection prevalence, intensity of infection, and urogenital morbidities.

pmc-11436266.title: Agitated Depression Associated With Flurazepam Discontinuation
pmc-11436266.creator: Mohamed Salih, Reem Mohamed Osman, Wala Alim, Leena Khalid, Wafa Sosal, Danya Ibrahim, Yassir Mahgoub
pmc-11436266.description: Agitated depression, also known as melancholia agitata, is a variant of depression characterized by severe symptoms of psychomotor agitation, inner unrest, anxiety, restlessness, prominent vegetative symptoms, and a high risk of suicide. This form of depression is reported to worsen with antidepressants and potentially improve with the use of ECT, lithium, antiepileptics, antipsychotics, and benzodiazepines.

pmc-11537932.title: Optimizing multi-environment trials in the Southern US Rice belt via smart-climate-soil prediction-based models and economic importance
pmc-11537932.creator: Melina Prado, Adam Famoso, Kurt Guidry, Roberto Fritsche-Neto
pmc-11537932.description: Rice breeding programs globally have worked to release increasingly productive and climate-smart cultivars, but the genetic gains have been limited for some reasons. One is the capacity for field phenotyping, which presents elevated costs and an unclear approach to defining the number and allocation of multi-environmental trials (MET).

pmc-11689716.title: CORRELATES BETWEEN SENSORY IMPAIRMENTS AND PAIN CHARACTERISTICS IN MEDICARE BENEFICIARIES
pmc-11689716.creator: Christina Mu, Alisha Thompson, Bailee Brekke, Safiyyah Okoye, Lama Assi, Sahar Assi, Soomi Lee
pmc-11689716.description: Objective. Sensory impairments (SI) are associated with comorbidities, functional difficulties, and poor self-rated health. Few studies have examined associations between SI and pain, which is a strong correlate of poor health in later life. We examined the associations between SI and pain. Methods.

pmc-12413453.title: Platelet factor 4 and stromal cell-derived factor are novel prognostic biomarkers for cerebral vasospasm and mortality after subarachnoid hemorrhage
pmc-12413453.creator: Dilaware Khan, Igor Fischer, Sihmehmet Sahan, Michael Hewera, Katharina Faust, Sajjad Muhammad
pmc-12413453.description: Aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage (aSAH) is a life-threatening condition associated with high rates of morbidity and mortality, mainly due to post-hemorrhagic complications such as cerebral vasospasm (CVS) and delayed cerebral ischemia (DCI). Recent evidence implicates platelet activation and inflammatory mediators in the cascade of secondary injury following aSAH. Monitoring and timely treatment of post-SAH complications is critical to improve clinical outcomes.

pmc-12788456.title: Evaluation of Virtual Surgical Planning in Accuracy and Efficiency of Complex Maxillofacial Trauma Reconstruction
pmc-12788456.creator: Jigar Prahelad Bhai Thakkar, Padmanabha Kumar Govindaraj, Pratesh Nitin Dholabhai, Pooja Arora, Sushree Arpita Priyadarsani, Sameer Gupta
pmc-12788456.description: Background:Complex maxillofacial trauma reconstruction presents significant challenges due to anatomical intricacies and the need for precise spatial restoration. Virtual surgical planning (VSP) has emerged as a promising technology to enhance surgical accuracy and efficiency.Objective:This study aimed to evaluate the accuracy and intraoperative efficiency of Virtual Surgical Planning in the reconstruction of complex maxillofacial trauma compared to conventional planning methods.

pmc-13272154.title: Integrated metabolomics and machine learning identify predictive biomarkers via SHAP analysis for sintilimab-induced rash in lung cancer patients
pmc-13272154.creator: Wenxiu Tian, Hehe Tang, Xiaoyuan Liu, Juan Lv, Yunyun Xu, Yujiao Hua, Fen Xie, Yongjuan Ding
pmc-13272154.description: BackgroundSintilimab-induced rash is a significant clinical challenge in lung cancer treatment, often necessitating therapy interruption or discontinuation and thereby compromising patient outcomes. The underlying mechanisms of this adverse event remain poorly understood. This study aimed to investigate potential predictive biomarkers and mechanisms of sintilimab-induced rash through metabolomic profiling.

pmc-13449914.title: Intramasseteric dermoid cyst: Imaging clues to a rare masticator space lesion
pmc-13449914.creator: Mohamed Bouallou, Issam Berrajaa, Achraf Amine Sbai, Drissia Benfadil, Azeddine Lachkar
